title: Annotated exemplar
body: Select the marked phrases to see why each one earns its place.
instruction: Read the paragraph, then tap the highlighted phrases for commentary.

_passage.text: Renewable energy is often presented as the single answer to climate change.
This paragraph argues that storage, not generation, is the real bottleneck.

_note.title: A clear thesis
_note.body: The writer states a specific, arguable position up front, so the reader knows exactly what the paragraph will defend.

_passage.text: battery costs fell by almost half between 2018 and 2023

_note.title: Evidence with figures
_note.body: A concrete, dated statistic supports the claim instead of a vague assertion the reader has to take on trust.

_passage.text: , which suggests storage is becoming viable at scale.
If the trend holds, policy should shift toward storage incentives.

_note.title: A reasoned implication
_note.body: The closing sentence follows from the evidence and links back to the thesis, rather than introducing a new idea at the end.
